The proposal is for the second phase of establishing DREAM (Design, Robotics, Electronics and Additive Manufacturing) Lab Clusters at a cost of 4.30 crore per cluster, comprising one Hub School and three Spoke Schools. The project aims to provide students with training in emerging technologies through a hub-and-spoke model, with funding shared between the industry consortium (68%) and Samagra Shiksha (32%). The project is planned for implementation over 5.5 years. In PAB 2025-26, an amount of 77.40 crore was approved for the first phase covering 18 DREAM Lab Clusters (@ 4.3 crore per cluster). However, as per the PRABANDH progress report, the State has incurred an expenditure of only 2 lakh during 2025-26 under this intervention. The State has informed that the MoU with the industry partner was signed only in May 2026, resulting in delays in project implementation. State may first make 1st phase labs functional.

Para 1 of the UP minutes says government institutions hold 52.3% of enrolment and 39.1% of teachers; para 3 says government schools hold 39.1% of enrolment and unaided schools 51.7%. The dashboard uses para 3 (39.1%), which is internally consistent with the unaided share.

The minutes do not define "spill over" the same way. Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra print Annexure II’s Balance Remaining (approved − completed − surrendered, before cancellations); Karnataka, Telangana print its Actual Spillover, net of the cancelled 2018-19 to 2020-21 works. Each state’s total is reconciled on its own basis; the Spill-over tab shows both measures.
The Maharashtra PAB approvals are interim: the Secretary stated that Samagra Shiksha 3.0 is pending approval and an additional PAB will supplement these approvals.

Maharashtra’s recommendation sheet uses a newer PRABANDH template with no Recurring / Non-recurring column. Each line item’s flag is taken from the same national activity code in the other states (or, for codes seen nowhere else, from its wording), and the resulting split reconciles exactly with Maharashtra’s own recurring and non-recurring totals for every major component.
The Maharashtra minutes’ index lists an Annexure IV school list, but the PDF supplied ends at Annexure III, so Maharashtra has no school-wise works on the Works & schools tab.

PRABANDH names the vocational sub component "Introduction of Skill Education at Secondary and higher Secondary" in line items and "Introduction of Vocational Education…" in its summary table. They are the same money (totals match to the paisa) and are shown under the summary-table name.
UP’s "Opening of New School" line items are rolled into "Opening of New / Upgraded Schools" in the PRABANDH summary table; the dashboard follows the summary table.
